Quantized Engine Integration & Execution Provider Selection

decisions_made.reason: Eliminates duplicate activity instances when tapping stories multiple times or returning from notifications.

decisions_made.decision: Tri-Layer Defense for Story Preparation & Content Fetching
decisions_made.reason: Prevents redundant network calls (Layer 3), avoids duplicate ONNX background preparation jobs (Layer 2), and stops activity stacking (Layer 1).
Saves ~30% RAM (802MB vs 1148MB) and improves RTF to ~0.83-0.90x on mobile devices without perceptible audio degradation.

decisions_made.decision: Dynamic INT8 on CPU / XNNPACK Execution Provider
decisions_made.reason: Quantizes MatMul/Gemm while preserving Conv float precision, achieving ~50% model size reduction with high audio quality.
Invalidates prewarmed cache, recreates ONNX session manager without service restart, and emits telemetry update.

decisions_made.decision: Precision Card Visibility Binding to VieNeu Engine
decisions_made.reason: Automatically hides precision selector when Google TTS is active and shows when VieNeu TTS is active.
